spots.name: King's College Chapel
spots.summary: King's College Chapel is the chapel of King's College in the University of Cambridge. It is considered one of the finest examples of Perpendicular Gothic architecture and features the world's largest fan vault.

names.ja: キングス・カレッジ・チャペル

spots.name: Corpus Christi College
spots.summary: Corpus Christi College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. From the late 14th century to the early 19th century it was also commonly known as Bene't College.

names.ja: コーパス・クリスティ・カレッジ (ケンブリッジ大学)
names.zh: 剑桥大学科珀斯克里斯蒂学院

spots.name: Fitzwilliam Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Fitzwilliam Museum is the art and antiquities museum of the University of Cambridge. It is located on Trumpington Street opposite Fitzwilliam Street in central Cambridge.

names.ja: フィッツウィリアム美術館

spots.name: Pembroke College
spots.summary: Pembroke College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge, England. The college is the third-oldest college of the university and has more than 700 students and fellows.

names.ja: ペンブルック・カレッジ
names.zh: 剑桥大学彭布罗克学院

spots.name: Mathematical Bridge
spots.summary: The Mathematical Bridge is a wooden footbridge in the southwest of central Cambridge, England. It bridges the River Cam about one hundred feet northwest of Silver Street Bridge and connects two parts of Queens' College. Its official name is simply the Wooden Bridge or Queens' Bridge. It is a Grade II listed building.

spots.name: Emmanuel College
spots.summary: Emmanuel College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. The college was founded in 1584 by Sir Walter Mildmay, Chancellor of the Exchequer to Elizabeth I.

names.ja: エマニュエル・カレッジ
names.zh: 剑桥大学伊曼纽尔学院

spots.name: Clare College
spots.summary: Clare College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge in Cambridge, England. The college was founded in 1326 as University Hall, making it the second-oldest surviving college of the University after Peterhouse.

names.ja: クレア・カレッジ (ケンブリッジ大学)

spots.name: Corpus Clock
spots.summary: The Corpus Clock, also known as the Chronophage or the Grasshopper clock, is a large sculptural clock on the outside of the Taylor Library at Corpus Christi College, University of Cambridge, in England.

names.ja: コーパス・クロック

spots.name: Trinity Hall
spots.summary: Trinity Hall is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. It is the fifth-oldest surviving college of the university, having been established in 1350 by William Bateman, Bishop of Norwich, to train clergymen in canon law after the Black Death.

names.ja: トリニティ・ホール大学

spots.name: Jesus College
spots.summary: Jesus College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. Jesus College was established in 1496 on the site of the twelfth-century Benedictine nunnery of St Mary and St Radegund by John Alcock, then Bishop of Ely. The cockerel is the symbol of Jesus College, after the surname of its founder.

names.ja: ジーザス・カレッジ (ケンブリッジ大学)

spots.name: Queens' College
spots.summary: Queens' College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. Queens' is one of the 16 "old colleges" of the university, and was founded in 1448 by Margaret of Anjou. Its buildings span the River Cam with the Mathematical Bridge and Silver Street connecting the two sides.

names.ja: クイーンズ・カレッジ (ケンブリッジ大学)

spots.name: Sidney Sussex College
spots.summary: Sidney Sussex College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge in England. The College was founded in 1596 under the terms of the will of Frances Sidney, Countess of Sussex (1531–1589), wife of Thomas Radclyffe, 3rd Earl of Sussex, and named after its foundress.

names.ja: シドニー・サセックス・カレッジ
names.zh: 剑桥大学悉尼·萨塞克斯学院

spots.name: Church of St Mary the Great

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: St Mary the Great is a Church of England parish and university church at the north end of King's Parade in central Cambridge, England. It is known locally as Great St Mary's or simply GSM to distinguish it from "Little St Mary's". It is one of the Greater Churches.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of St Mary the Great, Cambridge

names.nl: Kerk van St Mary the Great
names.ja: 聖メアリ大教会

spots.name: The Eagle
spots.summary: The Eagle is a Grade II listed public house in Cambridge, England, which opened in 1667 as a coaching inn. It is the second oldest pub in Cambridge, after the Pickerel Inn on Magdalene Street.

spots.name: Cambridge railway station
spots.summary: Cambridge railway station serves central Cambridge, in Cambridgeshire, England. Situated at the end of Station Road, it lies 1 mile (1.6 km) south-east of the city centre.

names.ja: ケンブリッジ駅

spots.name: Downing College
spots.summary: Downing College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge and currently has around 950 students. Founded in 1800, it was the only college to be added to the university between 1596 and 1869, and is often described as the oldest of the new colleges and the newest of the old.

names.ja: ケンブリッジ大学ダウニング・カレッジ

spots.name: Holy Sepulchre, Cambridge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre, generally known as The Round Church, is an Anglican church in the city of Cambridge, England. It is located on the corner of Round Church Street and Bridge Street. Since 1950 the church has been designated a Grade I listed building, and is currently managed by Christian Heritage.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Cambridge

spots.name: Bridge of Sighs
spots.summary: The Bridge of Sighs in Cambridge, England is a stone covered bridge at St John's College, Cambridge, England. It was built in 1831 and crosses the River Cam between the college's Third Court and New Court. The architect was Henry Hutchinson.

names.ja: ため息橋

spots.name: St Bene't's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St Bene't's Church is a Church of England parish church in central Cambridge, England. Parts of the church, most notably the tower, are Anglo-Saxon, and it is the oldest church in Cambridgeshire as well as the oldest building in Cambridge.

names.ja: セント・ベネッツ教会

spots.name: Trinity Street
spots.summary: Trinity Street is a street in central Cambridge, England. The street continues north as St John's Street, and south as King's Parade and then Trumpington Street.

names.ja: トリニティ・ストリート (ケンブリッジ)

spots.name: King's Parade
spots.summary: King's Parade is a street in central Cambridge, England. The street continues north as Trinity Street and then St John's Street, and south as Trumpington Street. It is a major tourist area in Cambridge, commanding a central position in the University of Cambridge area of the city.

spots.name: Cambridge Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Cambridge Castle, locally also known as Castle Mound, is in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. Built after the Norman Conquest of England in 1066 to control the strategically important route to the north of England, it played a role in the conflicts of the Anarchy and the First and Second Barons' Wars.

spots.name: Kettle's Yard
spots.summary: Kettle's Yard is an art gallery and house in Cambridge, England. The director of the art gallery is Andrew Nairne, who took up the post in November 2011. Both the house and gallery reopened in February 2018 after an expansion of the facilities.

spots.name: The Backs
spots.summary: The Backs is an area to the east of Queen's Road in the city of Cambridge, England, where several colleges of the University of Cambridge back on to the River Cam with their grounds covering both banks of the river.

names.ja: ザ・バックス

spots.name: Our Lady and the English Martyrs Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Our Lady of the Assumption and the English Martyrs, also known as the Church of Our Lady and the English Martyrs (OLEM), is an English Roman Catholic parish church located at the junction of Hills Road and Lensfield Road in southeast Cambridge.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Our Lady and the English Martyrs Church

names.it: Chiesa di Nostra Signora e dei Martiri inglesi
names.zh: 圣母暨英国殉道圣人堂

spots.name: Cambridge American Cemetery and Memorial
spots.summary: Cambridge American Cemetery and Memorial is a World War II American military war grave cemetery, lying between the villages of Coton and Madingley, 7 km (4.3 mi) north-west of Cambridge, England. The cemetery, dedicated in 1956, contains 3,811 American war dead and covers 30.5 acres (12.3 ha).

names.ja: ケンブリッジアメリカ人墓地

spots.name: Robinson College
spots.summary: Robinson College is a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. Founded in 1977, it is one of the newest Oxbridge colleges and is unique in having been intended, from its inception, for both undergraduate and graduate students of both sexes.

names.ja: ロビンソン・カレッジ

spots.name: Scott Polar Research Institute

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sun

spots.summary: The Scott Polar Research Institute (SPRI) is a centre for research into the polar regions and glaciology worldwide. It is a sub-department of the Department of Geography in the University of Cambridge, located on Lensfield Road in the south of Cambridge.

names.ja: スコット極地研究所

spots.name: Museum of Zoology

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The University Museum of Zoology is a museum of the University of Cambridge and part of the research community of the Department of Zoology. The public is welcome and admission is free (2018).

names.fr: Musée de zoologie de l'université de Cambridge
names.es: Museo de Zoología de la Universidad de Cambridge
names.zh: 剑桥大学动物学博物馆

spots.name: St Edward King and Martyr, Cambridge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St Edward King and Martyr is a church located on Peas Hill in central Cambridge, England. It is dedicated to Edward the Martyr, who was King of England from 975 until his murder in 978.
spots.wikipediaTitle: St Edward King and Martyr, Cambridge

spots.name: Whipple Museum of the History of Science

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Whipple Museum of the History of Science is a museum attached to the University of Cambridge, England, which houses an extensive collection of scientific instruments, apparatus, models, pictures, prints, photographs, books and other material related to the history of science.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Whipple Museum of the History of Science

names.es: Museo Whipple de Historia de la Ciencia

spots.name: Cambridge University Botanic Garden
spots.summary: The Cambridge University Botanic Garden is a botanical garden located in Cambridge, England, associated with the university Department of Plant Sciences. It lies between Trumpington Road to the west, Bateman Street to the north and Hills Road to the east.

names.fr: Jardin botanique de l'université de Cambridge
names.es: Jardín Botánico de la Universidad de Cambridge
names.ja: ケンブリッジ大学付属植物園

spots.name: Trinity College Chapel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Trinity College Chapel is the chapel of Trinity College, Cambridge, a constituent college of the University of Cambridge. Part of a complex of Grade I listed buildings at Trinity, it dates from the mid 16th century. It is an Anglican church in the Anglo-Catholic tradition.

spots.name: The Leys School
spots.summary: The Leys School is a co-educational private school in Cambridge, England. It is a boarding and day school for about 565 pupils between the ages of eleven and eighteen. The head is a member of the Headmasters' and Headmistresses' Conference.

names.ja: レイズ・スクール

spots.name: Murray Edwards College
spots.summary: Murray Edwards College is a women-focused constituent college of the University of Cambridge. It was founded in 1954 as New Hall and renamed in 2008.

names.ja: マレー・エドワーズ・カレッジ
names.zh: 剑桥大学默里·爱德华兹学院

spots.name: Cambridge Guildhall
spots.summary: Cambridge Guildhall is a civic building in the centre of the historic city of Cambridge, England. It includes two halls, The Large Hall and The Small Hall, and is used for many disparate events such as comedy acts, conferences, craft fairs, live music, talks, and weddings.

names.ja: ケンブリッジ・ギルドホール

spots.name: Wren Library
spots.summary: The Wren Library is the library of Trinity College in Cambridge. It was designed by Christopher Wren in 1676 and completed in 1695.

names.ja: レン図書館

spots.name: Cambridge University Library

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Cambridge University Library is the main research library of the University of Cambridge. It is the largest of over 100 libraries within the university. The library is a major scholarly resource for members of the University of Cambridge and external researchers. It is often referred to within the university as the UL.

names.es: Biblioteca de la Universidad de Cambridge
names.ja: ケンブリッジ大学図書館

spots.name: Cambridge Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cambridge Central Mosque is the first purpose-built mosque within the city of Cambridge, England. It opened to the public on 24 April 2019. The Mosque is a prominent Islamic centre located on Mill Road in the Romsey area of Cambridge.

spots.name: Bene't Street
spots.summary: Bene't Street is a short historic street in central Cambridge, England, the name being derived from St Benedict. There is a junction with King's Parade to the north and Trumpington Street to the south at the western end of the street. Free School Lane leads off to the south.

spots.name: Holy Trinity Church, Cambridge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Holy Trinity Church is a church in Market Street, in the city of Cambridge, in Cambridgeshire, England, on the corner with Sidney Street. Its current vicar is Stuart Browning. Theologically, it stands within the charismatic evangelical tradition of the Church of England.

names.ja: ホーリー・トリニティ教会

photo.author: joe from Currently located in Cork, Ireland.

spots.name: Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology, also known as MAA, at the University of Cambridge houses the university's collections of local antiquities, together with archaeological and ethnographic artefacts from around the world.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology, University of Cambridge

names.it: Museo di archeologia e antropologia dell'Università di Cambridge

spots.name: Clare College Bridge
spots.summary: Clare Bridge is the ninth bridge overall and the fifth River Cam bridge on its middle stream in Cambridge. The bridge now connects the Old Court of Clare College to Memorial Court, which was dedicated in 1926. It is a Grade I listed building.

spots.name: Sedgwick Museum of Earth Sciences

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Sedgwick Museum of Earth Sciences, is the geology museum of the University of Cambridge. It is part of the Department of Earth Sciences and is located on the university's Downing Site in Downing Street, central Cambridge, England.

names.es: Museo Sedgwick de Ciencias de la Tierra
names.zh: 塞德威克地球科學博物館

spots.name: Old Vicarage, Grantchester

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Old Vicarage in the Cambridgeshire village of Grantchester is a house associated with the poet Rupert Brooke, who lived nearby, and in 1912 referenced it in an eponymous poem – "The Old Vicarage, Grantchester". The house is next door to The Orchard tea garden, also part of the poem.

spots.name: Little St Mary's, Cambridge

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Little St Mary's or St Mary the Less is a Church of England parish church in Cambridge, England, on Trumpington Street between Pembroke College's Mill Lane Project development site and Peterhouse. The church is in the Diocese of Ely and follows the Anglo-Catholic or high-church tradition of the Church of England.

spots.name: St Andrew the Great

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St Andrew the Great is a Church of England parish church in central Cambridge. Rebuilt in late Gothic style in 1843, it is a Grade II listed building. The church has a conservative evangelical tradition. The congregation includes Cambridge residents, overseas visitors and students.

spots.name: Market Hill
spots.summary: Market Hill is the location of the marketplace in central Cambridge, England. Operating as a marketplace since Saxon times, a daily outdoor market with stalls continues to run there.

spots.name: Trumpington Street
spots.summary: Trumpington Street is a major historic street in central Cambridge, England. At the north end it continues as King's Parade where King's College is located. To the south it continues as Trumpington Road, an arterial route out of Cambridge, at the junction with Lensfield Road.

spots.name: Church of St Botolph
spots.summary: St Botolph's Church, Cambridge is a Church of England parish church in the city of Cambridge, England. The church is a Grade I listed building.

names.zh: 剑桥的圣博托尔夫教堂

spots.name: Trinity Lane
spots.summary: Trinity Lane is a street in the centre of Cambridge, England that passes through portions of the University of Cambridge, one of the world's most prestigious universities. The lane leads off Trinity Street.

spots.name: Parker Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Parker Library is a library within Corpus Christi College, Cambridge which contains rare books and manuscripts.

names.ja: パーカー・ライブラリー

spots.name: Petty Cury
spots.summary: Petty Cury is a pedestrianised shopping street in central Cambridge, England. It connects Market Hill, the location of Cambridge's central outdoor market, and Guildhall Street to the west with the shopping streets of Sidney Street and St Andrew's Street to the east.

spots.name: Cambridge Arts Theatre
spots.summary: The Arts Theatre Cambridge is a 664-seat theatre on Peas Hill and St Edward's Passage in central Cambridge, England. The theatre presents a varied mix of drama, dance, opera and pantomime. It attracts touring productions, as well as many shows direct from, or prior to, seasons in the West End.

names.ja: ケンブリッジ・アーツ・シアター

spots.name: Garret Hostel Bridge
spots.summary: Garret Hostel Bridge, colloquially known as Orgasm Bridge, is a foot and cycle bridge over the River Cam in Cambridge, England.

spots.name: Mill Road
spots.summary: Mill Road is a two-lane road in southeast Cambridge, England. It runs southeast from near to Parker's Piece, at the junction with Gonville Place, East Road, and Parkside. It crosses the main railway line and links to the city's ring road.

spots.name: Pepys Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Pepys Library of Magdalene College, Cambridge, is the personal library collected by Samuel Pepys which he bequeathed to the college following his death in 1703.

names.ja: ピープス図書館

spots.name: Silver Street
spots.summary: Silver Street is located in the southwest of central Cambridge, England. It links Queen's Road to the west with Trumpington Street to the east. The road continues west out of central Cambridge as Sidgwick Avenue.

spots.name: Cambridge University Catholic Chaplaincy

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cambridge University Catholic Chaplaincy, known as Fisher House after its patron the English martyr and Chancellor of Cambridge St John Fisher, is the Catholic Chaplaincy of the University of Cambridge in England. Founded in 1895, it has been on Guildhall Street, in Cambridge's city centre, since 1924.

spots.name: Reality Checkpoint
spots.summary: Reality Checkpoint is the humorous nickname of a large cast-iron lamppost in the middle of Parker's Piece, Cambridge, England, at the intersection of the park's diagonal paths. It gained the nickname in the early 1970s when it first appeared on the lamppost's base as graffiti, possibly by a student.

names.ja: リアリティ・チェックポイント

spots.name: Coe Fen
spots.summary: A beautiful, semi-wild green near the centre of the city, but far enough out to be quiet. Less manicured than some of the college gardens and parks around Cambridge, but nonetheless a great space to be in the summer with cows roaming and the Cam running through.

spots.name: Selwyn College
spots.summary: Founded in 1882, Selwyn is one of the newer Cambridge colleges. Its buildings and grounds are excellent examples of Gothic Revival architecture and it has been named one of the “most obviously impressive” of 68 listed buildings in the West Cambridge Conservation Area appraisal. Entering through the Porter's Lodge Gate on Grange Road puts you in the attractive Old Court with its manicured lawn surr

names.ja: セルウィン・カレッジ

spots.name: Newnham College
spots.summary: Newnham sits a little away from the central colleges and consequently, gets far fewer visitors. The grounds, however, are beautiful, peaceful and simply huge. Walking on the grass is permitted, unusual for Cambridge colleges.

spots.name: Homerton College
spots.summary: Homerton College is one of the newer colleges, though it has existed for centuries as an academic institution and is architecturally very pretty, with extensive and tranquil grounds and a picturesque orchard. It is in a beautiful location on Hills Road, about 15 minutes walk from the town centre. The Victorian hall here is one of the most beautiful in Cambridge and definitely worth a visit. Free t

names.ja: ホマトン・カレッジ

spots.name: Old Ticket Office

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat

spots.summary: Friendly bar with outdoor seating just next to the station, mostly commuters. Very comfortable seats, live train times on screen. City Pub Co. bought and renovated the former ticket office in 2018 and it's been very successful, with a handful of regulars despite being on the outskirts of town. Wide range of craft beers (more than 30!) and gins (more than 20), wines and cocktails. Extensive hot foo

spots.name: Fitzbillies

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Fitzbillies is a Cambridge institution serving refined food for lunches and dinners, as well as heavenly tea and pastries in the afternoon. Don't forget its adjacent shop selling the best pastries in town, amongst which you will find the world famous Chelsea Bun! They also have a smaller branch at 36 Bridge Street, which is often less busy.

spots.name: The Maypole

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A Cambridge institution, still independent and it's noticeable in its style and management. Smart pub, heated outdoor area. Enormous range of alcohol, perhaps slightly higher prices than the local average, but only slightly and it's worth it for the atmosphere. Late opening, last call's at 1 on weekends but boot-out's a good hour later.

spots.name: Café Blue Sage

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Turkish brunch spot. High-quality coffee, sweet and savoury pastries, and a selection of freshly-cooked hot food. Menemen and shakshouka available every day, with sublime çılbır available on weekdays. Very attentive service, but prepare to wait for a table or sit outside on Saturday and Sunday mornings -- it's not a big place

spots.name: The Castle Inn

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of the best and busiest, traditional pubs in Cambridge. With an eclectic mix of locals and visitors, it can get impossibly busy of Friday and Saturday nights, however, the beer is excellent (the wine less so) and the food is home cooked and good value - the "Castle Burger" is a popular choice.

spots.name: Restaurant 22

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Set in a converted Victorian house near the river. Serves up quality seasonal food from a monthly changing menu in an intermate dining room. Booking essential. Larger private room up stairs for parties of approx 12. One Michelin Star since 2023.

spots.name: The Regal

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Formerly a cinema, the Regal is the largest pub in the city. Offers a broad range of drinks including cheap ales you'd expect from a Wetherspoon chain pub, plus music and a rowdy dance floor on Friday and Saturday nights

spots.name: Thanh Binh

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Very good Vietnamese food in a pleasant atmosphere. No alcohol license, but you can bring your own; there is a good wine shop just over the bridge 50 m away.

spots.name: The Kingston Arms

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Underrated old-fashioned free house with friendly atmosphere, open later than other Cambridge bars (2AM weekends, drinking-up time generally half an hour).

spots.name: Champion Of The Thames

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Old style pub in the centre of town with a blazing fireplace in the winter. One of the few pubs to sell a local cider rather than the mass-produced stuff.

spots.name: Michaelhouse Cafe

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Beautiful cafe serving excellent sandwiches, salads, hot dishes, and soups. Desserts as well. Vegetarian options always available. Lunch served until 3PM.

spots.name: The Granta

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A large terrace looks out on the river and surrounding nature. Popular during the summer, this pub serves excellent food, and rents out punts and canoes.

spots.name: The Cambridge Chop House

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Good British cuisine in a great location, real ale (well kept!), attentive service, fixed lunch & (early) dinner menu (2 course). Booking recommended.

spots.name: Midsummer House
spots.summary: Midsummer Common. By far Cambridge's finest restaurant and one of only ten British restaurants to have earned two stars from the Michelin guide.

spots.name: Tatties

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Busy cafe serving jacket potatoes and sandwiches. Very popular with students around lunch time.

spots.name: De Luca Cucina & Bar

hours.note: Closed Fri, Sat

spots.summary: Great little Italian/British Fusion Restaurant with reasonable prices and great staff!

spots.name: Tipsy Vegan

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Good quality vegan bar-restaurant with outdoor area. Tables can be booked online.

spots.name: Savinos

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Authentic Italian coffee bar. Best espresso and cappuccino in town.

spots.name: Sala Thong Thai Restaurant
spots.summary: This small place serves simple tasty Thai food with good service.

spots.name: Little Rose
spots.summary: Gastro-pub style food.
